threads.body: The `description` scalar is unintentionally split across two lines with extra indentation, which introduces a newline into the value (and reads oddly as rendered). Collapse this into a single line or use a folded block scalar (`>`) so the rendered description is consistent and does not include an unintended line break.

threads.body: There are two separate metric definitions with the same metric `name: messaging.process.duration` but different attribute sets. This makes the catalog ambiguous for consumers that key off metric name (and increases the chance of inconsistent references over time). Prefer a single definition that lists the superset of attributes (if attributes are optional), or use distinct metric names if these are truly different metrics; then update any `metric_refs` to point to the consolidated definition.
